simulator.fresh_state: new space; agent position and velocity; T angle, then position; T velocity and angular velocity; no settling step

replay.reset: reset_to_state iterated 5 times so the body pose equals the recorded pose

solve.unknowns: u = (agent vx, vy, T vx, vy, l*omega), px/s, at the source positions
solve.residual: r = (agent dx, dy, T dx, dy, l*wrap(dtheta)), px; wrap to (-pi, pi]
solve.jacobian: central finite differences of r in u
solve.line_search: halve up to 8 times while ||r||_2 does not decrease

distance: max of the agent displacement and the T's largest keypoint displacement, px

stage_a.novelty: median previous-slot displacement from the source > scale
stage_a.indistinguishable: median oracle-learned previous-slot disagreement <= scale: stop without training

oracle: latent-state-assisted oracle with a fixed history decoder; history realizability not verified

operators.fresh: one step under the action from a freshly built state (no contact history): the solve
operators.actual_history: the demonstration replayed continuously from its first frame (same reset) to frame t, velocities substituted, one step under the action: acceptance
